title: RLC’s The Jewel anchors Q2 office leasing lead

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Robinsons Land Corp.’s office leasing arm led the country’s office transaction market in Q2 2026, driven by the largest individual office deal identified by CBRE Philippines. Robinsons Offices recorded 38,000 square meters of transactions in Q2 2026, the highest among developers, according to CBRE Philippines. READ: Robinsons Land defies H1 property downturn A 33,400-sq m pre-leasing commitment at Asscher, one of four towers in Robinsons Land’s The Jewel development, drove the performance. CBRE identified the deal as the country’s largest individual office transaction during the quarter. Asscher forms part of the ATMP Towers alongside Trilliant, Marquise and Peruzzi. The […]...
